pages.text: $(bold)Smith$() (the Forge): repairs what you hold for emeralds, by how worn it is. No XP, no "too expensive". He also clears anvil penalties and renames.$(br2)$(bold)Scribe$() (the Scriptorium): writes a copy of any Blueprint you know, for a friend, at half the charter price and a sheet of paper. Copies books and maps.

$(bold)Physician$() (the Infirmary): golden apples and potions on her table; sneak and talk for cures, lifting Bad Omen, and curing a zombie villager you bring her.$(br2)$(bold)Undertaker$(): brings your latest corpse to the capital graveyard, priced by distance; refunded if nothing is left.

$(bold)Courier$() (the Station): sends what you hold to any player, by rail. The further away they are, the longer it takes; it waits for them if they are offline.$(br2)$(bold)Keeper$() (the Lighthouse): a compass that always points to the lamp. $(bold)Exchange Merchant$() (the Market): ore from other regions, rare saplings, patterns and trims; fresh each dawn.

$(bold)The Hall of Heroes$() keeps a plaque for every boss: who brought it down first, and when. The record is kept from the first kill on, Hall or no Hall; a first kill is called out to everyone.$(br2)$(bold)Chronicler$() (the Hall): the whole record, every boss, first slayers, how often each has fallen and who has slain it most. The undefeated are a list of what is still out there.
